first.rationale: Onboarding simplification most directly addresses both current declines and has prior evidence of durable activation gains. Verify the original records to confirm segment definitions and guardrails, especially the early-churn risk for complex-workspace accounts; those accounts should retain the full flow. Promotional pricing is not preferred because its prior acquisition lift came with materially worse retention, conflicting with sustainable qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a guarded, segmented simplification experiment for SMB simple-workspace accounts only, measuring onboarding completion, activation, retention, and qualified revenue. Preserve the full onboarding flow for complex-workspace accounts because the archived test showed 60-day churn increased 9% when required setup steps were removed. This direction directly addresses both current declines and is supported by confirmed SMB gains in activation and qualified revenue. Do not generalize beyond SMB or simple workspaces without further evidence.
